entry.hook: Jade Pool (Yao Chi), the celestial retreat of the Queen Mother of the West, is not merely a garden of peaches—it is the universe’s most ancient and perfect crucible of yin-yang equilibrium, where every soul, god or mortal, stands naked under the mirror of its jade waters.

body.body_1:
瑶池 / Jade Pool (Yao Chi)
Type: 西王母的道场 (Queen Mother of the West's Daoist Retreat)
Domain: Celestial Realm (天界) / Grotto-Heaven (洞天福地)
Law Aspect: Supreme Yin-Yang Equilibrium, mediated by primordial yin energy drawn from the void
Spatial Medium: Eternal Immortal Nectar (琼浆玉液), a self-sustaining liquid energy source
Spiritual Density: Ultra-Dense; the pool's waters condense law itself
Spatial Extent: A suspended terrace atop the peak of Kunlun, known as Xuanpu (悬圃)
body.body_2: The Jade Pool is situated on the Xuanpu Terrace, the summit of the Kunlun Mountains, which before the Great Disconnection (Jue Di Tian Tong) served as a ladder between Heaven and Earth. After the Disconnection, the terrace was fully incorporated into the Celestial Realm, isolated from the mortal world by unbreakable law barriers. It lies within the western precincts of the heavenly domain, at a moderate distance from the Heavenly Court's administrative core. No other major celestial landmark borders it directly; the pool's boundaries are defined by the Queen Mother's will and the inherent purity of its spatial law.
body.body_3: The Jade Pool is not a natural body of water. Its basin is a crystalline depression in the celestial bedrock, lined with jade that predates the formation of the stars. The pool is filled not with water but with an Eternal Immortal Nectar (琼浆玉液) that never freezes and never evaporates. This nectar is the condensed essence of primordial yin energy, drawn from the void itself and balanced by the Queen Mother's presence to achieve perfect yin-yang harmony. No terrestrial dragon vein feeds the pool; its energy is self-sustaining and distinct from both Xian Tian Ling Qi and Hou Tian Ling Qi. The surrounding terrace is composed of a pale, luminous stone that radiates a constant, cool light. At the center of the pool rise three thousand Peach Trees of Immortality, each rooted in the nectar and drawing law directly from the cosmic fabric.
body.body_4: The ecology of the Jade Pool is unique to the Celestial Realm. The only flora are the three thousand peach trees, which bear fruit once every three thousand years. Each peach encodes fragments of celestial law and condensed lifespan. The pool's nectar supports no algae or fish; its purity rejects all organic life except the peaches. The only fauna permitted are the Queen Mother's attendant beings—blue phoenixes, jade maidens, and the occasional celestial crane—none of which feed on the pool. The space exhibits no temporal anomalies; time flows at the standard Celestial rate (roughly one day per mortal year). The climate is perpetually mild, regulated by the Queen Mother's will, with a soft, golden light that never dims. A subtle pressure affects all visitors: the pool's reflecting surface makes every hidden thought and impurity visible to the self, an effect of the space's karmic mirroring property.
body.body_5: The Jade Pool has never been subject to territorial conflict. It has been the sole domain of the Queen Mother of the West since the Honghuang Era. As one of the oldest and most powerful innate goddesses, the Queen Mother's authority over this space has never been challenged by any celestial faction. No blood has been spilled here; no formation anchors bones beneath the jade. The pool's undisturbed peace is itself a statement of absolute sovereignty.
body.body_6: The Jade Pool serves four cosmic functions within the Celestial Realm's order. First, as the seat of the Peach Orchard, it provides a regulated source of extended lifespan and cultivation advancement for all immortals, preventing chaotic competition for immortality. Second, as the venue of the Peach Banquet, it serves as a diplomatic space where the Queen Mother hosts the entire celestial pantheon every three thousand years, using the feast to assess the harmony of divine hierarchies and ease tensions between the Heavenly Court and other realms. Third, as the Witnessing Ground of the Oath of Female Immortals, it is the only certified location where all matters of promotion, punishment, and descent of female celestial beings must be recorded and sanctioned by the Queen Mother, making it the supreme juridical reference for the feminine path of cultivation (Kun Dao). Fourth, as the highest manifestation of yin law, it provides the ultimate calibration point for all female cultivators seeking the purest yin-yang balance.
body.body_7: Several mysteries remain. The exact mechanism by which the peach trees convert ambient law into edible fruit has never been decoded, even by the highest sages. The true depth of the Jade Pool's basin is unknown; the nectar extends beyond all probed limits, and some traditions whisper that it reaches into the void of primordial chaos. The nature of the reflected-self pressure—whether it is a passive property of the pool or an active function of the Queen Mother's will—remains unsettled. No ancient ruins or unexplored chambers have been reported beneath the terrace, but the pool's opacity to certain divination methods suggests hidden layers.
body.body_8: The Jade Pool's relationship with the major paths is defined by exclusive jurisdiction. With the Immortal Path: all registered immortals are entitled to attend the Peach Banquet, and the pool is the ultimate certification ground for Kun Dao practitioners. With the Divine Path: the Queen Mother is a central divine figure, and the pool operates under the overarching framework of the Celestial Decrees, though no Tian Tiao directly regulates the pool's internal law. With the Buddhist Path: no permanent Buddhist presence exists at the pool, but emissaries from Lingshan occasionally attend the Peach Banquet as guests. With the demonic and ghostly paths: entry is categorically barred; the pool's pure yin-yang equilibrium would dissolve any ghostly or demonic essence on contact.
body.body_9: The Jade Pool remains in a state of cosmic stasis. Its spiritual energy shows no depletion; the nectar is self-renewing and the peach trees continue their three-thousand-year cycle without deviation. The spatial law is perfectly stable, with no signs of degradation. No future territorial conflict is anticipated, given the Queen Mother's uncontested authority. The pool will likely remain the fixed node of celestial hospitality and female immortal governance for the remainder of the current cosmic eon.
body.body_10: None. The Jade Pool is entirely within the Celestial Realm and has no accessible remnants or entry points in the mortal world. The Xuanpu Terrace is sealed by law barriers after the Great Disconnection; no geographical feature on Kunlun's mortal slopes corresponds to the celestial platform.
body.body_11: This entry is structurally linked to the following associated articles: the Queen Mother of the West, whose person and authority define the Jade Pool's sovereignty; the Peach of Immortality, the primary treasure cultivated within the pool; the Kunlun Mountains, the terrestrial anchor of the celestial terrace; the Heavenly Court, the broader administrative realm to which the pool belongs; the Xuanpu Terrace, the specific platform housing the pool; and the Peach Banquet, the periodic diplomatic event hosted here.

guide.guide_1: Imagine you're standing on a mountain peak so high that the sky below you is a blue-green ocean, and above you, the air itself turns to liquid light. Now imagine that at this peak, there is a pool filled not with water but with a jade-colored nectar that never freezes, never evaporates, and reflects your soul more clearly than any mirror. That's the Jade Pool. In the West, we might compare it to the Garden of the Hesperides or the spring of Idun, but those are just cheap echoes. The Jade Pool is not a garden—it is the universe's most ancient social contract made visible, a diplomatic engine wrapped in peach blossoms, a regulator of godly lifespans, and a courtroom for every female immortal that has ever risen through the celestial ranks. And at its center, three thousand trees drop fruit that contain condensed cosmic law. Let me show you why this place matters more than any treasure vault.
guide.guide_2: You've probably heard of the Jade Pool in passing—maybe from a novel or a game where it's a mythical garden with magic peaches. That's like saying the Supreme Court is a room with a gavel. Yes, technically true. But the function is everything. In this cosmic geography, the Jade Pool is the single point where the entire immortal caste's biological continuity is regulated. Those peaches aren't snacks—they are the only sanctioned mechanism for extending an immortal's lifespan without triggering heavenly tribulation. The pool's waters don't just look beautiful; they enforce a karmic mirror that keeps every guest honest. So when I say this is the Queen Mother's retreat, don't think spa. Think of a fortified summit from which the most powerful female deity in the cosmos manages the diplomatic and biological infrastructure of divinity itself. Let's unlearn the tourist map. The real map is a law topology.
guide.guide_3: How was the Jade Pool born? The information we have says it predates the Great Disconnection, which means it's older than the current barrier between Heaven and Earth. The pool's nectar is not ordinary spiritual energy—it's a cosmic byproduct of the Queen Mother's primordial yin power, balanced against the yang of the celestial realm. Think of it as the ultimate equalizer: the pool draws extreme yin from the void and then the Queen Mother's will harmonizes it into perfect stability. That's why the space feels so oppressive to visitors—it's not an attack, it's the world's most sensitive scale. Every impurity, every hidden agenda, is immediately visible. The peach trees? They're not plants. They're law-concentrators. The fruit is a physical manifestation of cosmic rules that can be eaten to absorb those rules into your own cultivation. That's why you can't just plant a peach pit and grow another one. The tree only grows in the pool's nectar, and the nectar only exists because of the Queen Mother's specific cosmic position. No other space in the Three Realms replicates this.
guide.guide_4: Now, the blood-soaked history you might expect from a high-value celestial resource? There is none. Not a single recorded battle, not a single murder, not a single siege. That's not because the peaches aren't valuable—they are possibly the most valuable single asset in the Celestial Realm. It's because the Queen Mother of the West is an innate goddess who has held this territory since before the gods themselves organized into pantheons. No one has ever been stupid enough to challenge her directly. The Jade Pool is the rare exception in cosmic geography: a pristine node that has never needed to be defended. The bones beneath the foundation are zero. And that silence is more terrifying than any battlefield. It means the Queen Mother's power is so absolute that conflict simply does not arise.
guide.guide_5: What cosmic function does the Jade Pool serve? Four things, and each one is a planetary-scale job. First, the peach orchard provides a controlled release of lifespan extension, preventing chaos from immortals stealing life force or fighting over natural treasures. Second, the Peach Banquet every three thousand years is a diplomatic summit where the Queen Mother reads the political temperature of the entire celestial realm—who sits where, who gets which peach, who is conspicuously absent—all of it data that keeps the heavenly order stable. Third, it is the official witness ground for all matters concerning female immortals: promotions, punishments, marriages, descents to the mortal world. The Queen Mother is the judge and registrar. Fourth, it serves as the ultimate calibration point for the feminine path of cultivation. Every female cultivator who reaches a certain level must, at some point, have her state measured against the pool's yin-yang standard. Without the Jade Pool, the entire system of divine bureaucracy would lack a spine.
guide.guide_6: What still puzzles the scholars? The pool's full depth has never been charted—some whisper it connects to the undifferentiated chaos below the cosmic floor. The exact physics of how a peach encodes law into edible matter remains a mystery that even the highest sages cannot fully explain. And the reflective pressure that visitors feel—is it the pool's passive property or the Queen Mother's active enforcement? No one knows for sure because no one has ever dared to break protocol at the banquet. These are not dangers in the forbidden zone sense; they are epistemological gaps. If you come expecting adventure and ancient traps, you'll be disappointed. If you come expecting the most controlled, most regulated, most diplomatic piece of real estate in the known universe, the Jade Pool will not disappoint.
guide.guide_7: So what does the Jade Pool tell us about this cosmic geography? It tells us that the most powerful nodes are not always the most violent. Sometimes, the rarest resource in existence—immortal-grade lifespan extension—is managed through protocol and ritual rather than bloodshed. That's a radical statement in a universe where most spiritual nodes are fought over to the last drop of blood. The Jade Pool exists as a counterexample: a place that has never been conquered because its owner is too ancient, too wise, and too powerful to be challenged. It reminds us that geography is not just resource allocation—it is also law, custom, and the shadow of a single being's will. The queen sits at the center of the pool, and the entire divine order breathes around her. That's the truest metaphor for how space and power intertwine in this world. The land remembers who holds it. The Jade Pool remembers its only queen.

lore_entries.description: The hanging terrace on the summit of Kunlun, where the Jade Pool is located. A platform suspended between heaven and earth.
A fruit from the three thousand trees at the Jade Pool that encodes fragments of celestial law and grants extended lifespan. Ripens once every three thousand years.
The grand tri-millennial feast hosted by the Queen Mother of the West at the Jade Pool, where celestial guests are ranked and divine hierarchies assessed.
The feminine path of cultivation, whose highest reference and juridical ground is the Jade Pool.
The jade-colored liquid that fills the Jade Pool, a self-sustaining condensation of primordial yin energy that never freezes or evaporates.

faq_entries.question: Is the Jade Pool accessible to mortals?
faq_entries.answer: No. After the Great Disconnection, the pool became part of the Celestial Realm and is sealed behind law barriers. Only immortals with proper invitation may enter.

faq_entries.question: How often do the peaches ripen?
faq_entries.answer: Once every three thousand years. The Peach Banquet is held at each ripening.

faq_entries.question: What happens to a demon who tries to enter the Jade Pool?
faq_entries.answer: The pool's pure yin-yang equilibrium would dissolve any demonic essence on contact. Entry is prohibited for ghosts, demons, and any being with impure cultivation.

faq_entries.question: Why is the Queen Mother of the West's authority unchallenged?
faq_entries.answer: She is an innate goddess from the Honghuang Era with primordial power. No celestial faction has ever dared to contest her sovereignty over the Jade Pool.
